verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents a stability score defined as the proportion of user sessions that are error-free, with configurable stability targets. It also documents filtering the dashboard by release (including a "does not equal" release filter) and release annotations on the timeline for correlating versions with error-rate changes. That covers crash-free sessions and per-release error views, but the rest of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: crash-free users metric, adoption-per-release tracking, an explicit side-by-side canary-vs-stable release comparison, per-release stability breakdown, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
